# Storyboard: promo-umkm (30 s)

## Frame 1 — Hook
- time: 0.00–3.00
- scene: Large headline on a dark background, the word WEBSITE in the accent colour; the narrator waves in from the left.
- engine: remotion
- asset: kit shapes only; narrator character
- vo: 0.20–2.80 "UMKM kamu sudah punya website?"
- text: 0.30–2.70 "WEBSITE UNTUK UMKM"
- narrator: wave 0.10–1.60 R
- reads: a direct question to small business owners
- sfx: impact @0.00 gain=0.8
- sound: soft impact at 0.0 s

## Frame 2 — Problem
- time: 3.00–8.00
- scene: A plain, outdated shop page fades to grey next to the headline; the narrator points at the headline.
- engine: remotion
- asset: UI mock built from kit shapes (no real client screenshots)
- vo: 3.20–7.60 "Usaha kecil sulit berkembang kalau terlihat kurang profesional."
- text: 3.40–7.40 "TERLIHAT KURANG PROFESIONAL"
- narrator: point 4.00–6.50 R at headline
- reads: looking unprofessional costs customers
- sfx: whoosh @3.00 gain=0.7
- sound: low pulse

## Frame 3 — Solution
- time: 8.00–14.00
- scene: PrvTech wordmark reveal, then a clean storefront UI assembles from cards.
- engine: remotion
- asset: Asset/owner/prvtech-logo.svg (from the owner, needed before the build)
- vo: 8.20–13.90 "PrvTech bikin website dan software bisnis yang rapi, modern, siap pakai."
- text: 8.40–13.40 "RAPI. MODERN. SIAP PAKAI."
- narrator: present 8.60–11.00 R
- reads: PrvTech builds tidy, modern, ready-to-use software
- sound: whoosh at 8.0 s

## Frame 4 — Features demo
- time: 14.00–21.00
- scene: Dashboard with three tabs (toko, kasir, laporan). The cursor visits each tab and clicks; then the camera zooms into the report chart.
- engine: remotion
- asset: dashboard built from kit shapes
- vo: 14.20–20.60 "Dari toko online, sistem kasir, sampai laporan keuangan, sesuai kebutuhan bisnismu."
- cursor: tab-toko @15.00 click
- cursor: tab-kasir @16.40 click
- cursor: tab-laporan @17.80 click
- zoom: laporan-chart 18.40–20.90 scale=1.5
- reads: online store, POS and finance reports in one place
- sound: soft click on each tab

## Frame 5 — Payoff
- time: 21.00–25.00
- scene: The finished storefront on a laptop frame, calm hold.
- engine: remotion
- asset: kit shapes
- vo: 21.20–23.80 "Tampil rapi di mata pelanggan."
- text: 21.40–24.60 "TAMPIL RAPI"
- reads: the result looks professional
- sound: chord resolve

## Frame 6 — CTA
- time: 25.00–30.00
- scene: Domain and a button, clean hold to the end.
- engine: remotion
- asset: wordmark text
- vo: 25.20–28.95 "Yuk, kunjungi prvtech.id, konsultasi gratis!"
- text: 25.40–29.60 "prvtech.id"
- reads: visit the site and ask for a free consultation
- sound: sparkle, music ends clean
